main.description: UNSPSC 2-digit segment catalog entry. AT Protocol record carrying the canonical segment taxonomy — `code` is the 2-digit segment code (rkey verbatim for idempotent re-seeding), `slug` is the url-safe identifier from `60-apps/etzhayyim-project-open-unispsc/segments.csv`, `name` is the English title. Per ADR-2605172000 substrate posture: this is the published-catalog companion to the existing `com.etzhayyim.apps.openUnispsc.segment` *procedure* (which resolves a segment as a business-portfolio boundary at runtime). The procedure performs active business logic; this record persists the taxonomy on PDS so the substrate pipeline (mst-projector → ipfs-pinner → anchor-cron) can anchor + replicate the segment list without trusting this operator. Family / class / commodity layers follow the same record-vs-procedure split when their kotoba taxonomy publishers land in future PRs.

code.description: UNSPSC 2-digit segment code (e.g. '10', '43'). Used as the AT-record rkey for idempotent seeding.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens) for the segment. e.g. 'live-animals', 'communications-devices'. Sourced from segments.csv.

name.description: Canonical English name of the segment.

description.description: Optional free-text description; absent in v1 because segments.csv ships only (code, slug, name).

cpcSection.description: Optional primary CPC concordance section for this segment, when known (per the segment-range → CPC-section mapping documented in the open-unispsc CLAUDE.md).

publishedAt.description: Timestamp when this segment entry was published. Defaults to the UNSPSC v25 baseline 2023-08-15 unless the seeder overrides.
